title: Regional Director
summary: Experienced Regional Director to lead engineering operations, project delivery, site teams, subcontractors and client relationships.
description: Experienced Regional Director to lead engineering operations, project delivery, site teams, subcontractors and client relationships.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Deliver annual turnover and margin targets; oversee tenders, resource planning, risk assessments and Project Sponsor assignments.
Manage projects from inception to handover, controlling budgets, schedules, quality and safety.
Lead project and site managers, resolve escalations, monitor KPIs and ensure environmental, safety and quality compliance.
Coordinate workforce and subcontractors, manage commercial risks and maintain long-term client relationships.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Degree or professional qualification in engineering or construction management preferred.
Experience as a Regional Director, Operations Director or Senior Project Manager in M&E, construction or infrastructure.
Extensive large-scale mechanical and electrical project delivery, cost control and team management experience.
Strong stakeholder management; legal right to work in relevant EU country without sponsorship; valid driving licence.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Leadership, financial accountability, client focus, safety, communication and resilience.
